description: This file defines the RoutingFormsService class, which handles routing form responses, extracting routing URLs, and retrieving event type information based on URL parameters and external repositories.

classes.name: RoutingFormsService
classes.description: Service class for handling routing form responses, URL extraction, and event type retrieval.

methods.name: calculateSlotsBasedOnRoutingFormResponse
methods.description: Calculates available slots based on routing form response, fetching event type ID and available slots.

methods.name: getRoutedEventTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves the event type ID from a routed URL, throwing exceptions if not found or invalid.

methods.name: getRoutingUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the routing URL from request parameters and external URL data.

methods.name: extractTeamIdAndEventTypeSlugFromRedirectUrl
methods.description: Extracts team ID and event type slug from a routing URL.

methods.name: isEventTypeRedirectUrl
methods.description: Checks if the URL is an event type redirect URL based on query parameters.

methods.name: extractTeamIdFromRoutedUrl
methods.description: Extracts the team ID from the routing URL's search parameters.

methods.name: extractEventTypeFromRoutedUrl
methods.description: Extracts the event type slug from the URL pathname.
